entries.name: Anchoring bite
entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Anchoring bite

*One head holds the prey while the others watch its companions.*

**Target:** One creature within 2 squares. **Player defense:** Brawn. **Damage type:** physical.

**Weak defense:** Grappled 2. **Standard defense:** Grappled 1.

**Limit:** The holder suffers its own Grappled contribution. A new result replaces its lower contribution, not adds to it. Release freely; separation beyond reach, unconsciousness or death ends the hold.

entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Tail Retort

*The dragon twists with the blow and its heavy tail sweeps across the attacker's footing.*

After an adjacent attacker's attack resolves and deals HP damage to this creature, push that attacker 2 squares directly away. This creature must survive and remain capable. Apply Stability, terrain costs and normal collision damage; no separate attack damage. Cannot trigger from a free attack or another retaliatory effect.

details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Heavy Frame — Passive:** Stability 2; an explicit creature trait, not a bonus from size.

**Weakness:** Fire damage suppresses Knit Flesh until its next recovery.

**Knit Flesh:** At turn end, recover 3 HP if above 0, unless it took fire damage since its previous turn end. Dies at 0; cannot regrow from death.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Signs:** Several bite sizes mark the same carcass beside an immense trail.

**Purpose:** Guard a deep feeding pool.

**Tactics and retreat:** Sweep two targets with separate heads; regenerate until fire forces it to retreat.

**Counterplay and conversation:** Use fire and high ground; multiple heads do not give it multiple turns.

**Habitat:** Deep marsh; lake · **Communication:** None

**Loot:** One old wreck in its pool may hold 120 coins of recoverable cargo.

**Summoning:** Ineligible.
details.designNotesMarkdown:
## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-many-headed-marsh-wyrm


**Category:** Dragon · **Role:** Many-target brute · **CV:** 62

### Creature-roll reference

| Attack | Attribute | Attack modifier | Weak attack | Standard attack | Strong attack |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crossing jaws | Brawn | 1 Boon | 5 physical damage. | 7 physical damage. | 9 physical damage. |
| Anchoring bite | Brawn | 1 Boon | 3 physical damage. | 5 physical damage; Grappled 1. | 7 physical damage; Grappled 2. |

The incoming attack names the defense attribute; use the six values above. Same targeting, costs and limits apply in either perspective. No opposed second roll.


### CV worksheet

**Difficulty rationale:** A slow or broad exposed body gives the attacker a Boon. Its dangerous attack imposes defense Banes.

**Reference damage:** 5/7/9

**Reference type:** physical

**Expected targets:** 2

**Utility factor:** 1.45

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.3 → 1.45: Maneuver allowance +0, Reaction allowance +0.15. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 3

Reference I=3.596, O=13.191. CV uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/bestiary/encounters.md); action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.

**Ability sources:** [knit flesh](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/knit-flesh.md), [sweeping attack](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/sweeping-attack.md), [Tail Retort](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/tail-retort.md).

# Knit Flesh

*The torn flesh crawls together, leaving a wet seam that opens again when touched by flame.*

## Rules

**ID:** monster-knit-flesh


**Action:** Passive

At the end of its turn, if above 0 HP, recover the printed amount. Taking any fire damage since the end of its previous turn suppresses this recovery once. This is innate regeneration, not spell healing; it never revives the dead. A summoned version lacks this trait unless its summon entry explicitly permits it.

**Limits:** Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed
entry values and restrictions apply; no ability grants unlisted actions.

[Creature procedure](../bestiary/procedure.md) · [Monster ability index](README.md)

**Action:** Main Action
